item.title: Before COVID, the grab-and-go deli sandwiches at my local ma…
item.author: Feral Maui Hermit (@mauigreg.bsky.social)
item.description:
Before COVID, the grab-and-go deli sandwiches at my local market cost $4.99 each. From 2020 to 2025, they stayed around $7.99-$8.99. Now they are $12.99-$14.99.
It's all airport pricing now. It's "They're trapped here. They'll pay whatever we want," except for the entire country.
